$comment: Field definitions for the ARA discharge point layers (ARA_inlet_<year>).

fields.name: ARA_Nr
fields.title: Plant number
fields.description: Identification number of the treatment plant. Joins to the catchment and location layers of the same year.

fields.name: Adresse
fields.title: Plant name
fields.description: Name of the treatment plant. The field name says address but the content is the plant name; kept as-is so the file and this description agree.

fields.name: GEWISS_Nr
fields.title: Water body number
fields.description: Identifier of the receiving water body in the GEWISS register. The expansion of GEWISS is not confirmed; see eawag:pending.

fields.name: NAME
fields.title: Water body name
fields.description: Name of the water body receiving the treated effluent.

fields.name: Source
fields.title: Source
fields.description: Which dataset the discharge point information came from.

fields.name: Comment
fields.title: Comment
fields.description: Notes, including where there is no receiving water body and the effluent seeps away instead.

fields.name: inlet_x
fields.title: Easting
fields.description: Easting of the discharge point in EPSG:2056. A convenience copy of the geometry rather than an independent measurement.

fields.name: inlet_y
fields.title: Northing
fields.description: Northing of the discharge point in EPSG:2056. A convenience copy of the geometry rather than an independent measurement.

eawag:pending: Confirm what GEWISS stands for. It appears as a keyword in the FOEN geocat record but the expansion was not verified, so it has deliberately not been written down as fact.
Confirm whether inlet_x and inlet_y can ever disagree with geom.
Confirm the missing-value convention actually used in the files, then add a missingValues array to this schema.
